en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, straight, tree‑lined avenue with pedestrians walking along a dirt or early paved road. Utility poles line the street and the scene recedes into the distance. The margins of the image include captions in Greek and French/Latin letters identifying the place as Calamata and the specific street as Rue Faron. A modern website watermark (elia.org.gr) appears over the lower right of the image.
